payout_quote: Refer a friend to Regions and you both get a $50 reward when they open a new personal checking account.
steps: Be a Regions Bank customer and log in to Offer Tracker with your online banking credentials
Click Send a Referral under the Refer a Friend section and provide your friend's contact info and email; they get an email notification

Friend registers via the email, opens a new Regions personal checking account, and within 60 days: enrolls in online statements, has at least one $300+ ACH direct deposit, and makes at least 10 Regions Visa Debit Card purchases that post
You both receive a $50 reward after all offer requirements are met
catches: Cap: up to $500 per calendar year in referral rewards (10 x $50)
Friend must be new-to-Regions (cannot be an existing Regions checking customer)
Friend requirements within 60 days of opening: enroll in online statements, one $300+ ACH direct deposit, 10 Visa debit purchases
Business referrals: $50 reward for you and $150 for the business (business must open with $500+ deposit, one Visa Business debit purchase, enroll in online statements within 60 days)
Referrer logs into Offer Tracker via online banking; offer tracker eligibility rules apply
biggest_catch: Your friend must hit three bars within 60 days: a $300+ ACH direct deposit, 10 debit-card purchases, and online statements — miss one and nobody gets paid.
eligibility: Existing Regions Bank customers who log into Offer Tracker; referred friends must be new Regions personal checking customers
timing: Friend must complete requirements within 60 days of account opening; referrer cap resets per calendar year
